counterfactuals.change: Change only A[0][1] from +4 to -4 and its dependent operation multiplier from -2 to +2; regenerate dependent B, choices and explanation.
counterfactuals.expected: First missing operation changes from subtracting 2C1 to adding 2C1; old pair is rejected.

counterfactuals.justification: Pivot is +2, so coefficient sign must reverse to zero the changed row entry.

counterfactuals.change: Hold pivot row and operations fixed; change A[1][2] from 2 to 7 and recompute B.
counterfactuals.expected: Correct operation pair remains (-2,3), while affected off-row matrix entries change.
counterfactuals.observed: Answer pair preserved; new intermediate/final entries and solution verified; native grader accepts the same mathematical pair under the new choice ID.
counterfactuals.justification: The multiplier is determined by the pivot-row ratio; off-row entry changes do not alter that ratio.

counterfactuals.change: Hold A and all operations fixed; change supplied operation from C4 to C2.
counterfactuals.expected: Requested pair changes from (C2,C3) with (-2,3) to (C3,C4) with (3,-4).
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt blanks, answer operations, explanatory conclusion and native grader track the new targets; A/B remain identical.
counterfactuals.justification: Which operation is supplied is incidental, but directly determines which two the learner must infer.
